what_happens: A student's card is read at the door of a teaching room. Sessions followed remotely under an approved accommodation have no card reading.
Instructors enter midterm marks in the registry. Bridging-year entrants are marked in the bridging programme's own system for their first two years, and those marks are not copied over.
The limits of 75% attendance and 2.5 were set in 2023 from one year of records of two colleges, Business and Engineering.
'Struggled' means a term grade average below 2.5. A student who withdraws during the term keeps the average of the courses completed.
An advisor contacts each referred student. Students who are helped may pass, and then count as referrals that were 'not needed'.
The unit reports one referral rate and one hit rate for the whole University each term.
